whyPoints.body: CyberSygn's AI finds the signature, date, and initial fields on a listing agreement or offer in about three seconds, so you send the document from the showing instead of back at the office. No manual dragging of fields onto every page.

whyPoints.body: Buyers and sellers open the link, sign on their phone, and they are done. There is no account to create and no app to install, which matters when you need a disclosure initialed tonight, not next week.

whyPoints.body: Each completed document carries a SHA-256 audit certificate showing who signed, when, and that the file has not been altered since. When a transaction gets questioned months later, you have a clean, tamper-evident audit trail on file.

whyPoints.body: Plans run from one dollar to nineteen dollars a month with a genuinely useful free tier, so a solo agent can send disclosures without a per-envelope meter running in the background.

faqs.q: Can my buyers sign an offer from their phone without downloading anything?
faqs.a: Yes. You send a link, they open it in their phone browser, and they sign. There is no account to create and no app to install, which is why it works well for signatures you need the same evening.

faqs.q: Does CyberSygn detect the signature fields on a standard listing agreement automatically?
faqs.a: It does. The AI scans the document and places signature, date, and initial fields where they belong in about three seconds. You can move or add any field before sending if you want to adjust it.

faqs.q: Will a signed disclosure hold up if a transaction is disputed later?
faqs.a: Every completed document gets a tamper-evident SHA-256 audit certificate recording who signed and when, so you can show the file has not changed since signing. We are not a law firm, so confirm your state and brokerage requirements for specific forms.
